title: Templars persecuted by Philip the Fair and burned in 1307

tellings.quote: spitting on the cross. And they all ended up getting burnt at the stake in 1307.

plain: The Knights Templar, a medieval order of Christian knights, were persecuted by Philip the Fair, king of France, accused of things such as spitting on the cross, and "all ended up getting burnt at the stake in 1307," Michels says. He tells this himself in a talk with the researcher Randall Carlson, drawing on the esoteric thinker Rudolf Steiner. He brings it up as an example of a group with secret knowledge that was destroyed by those in power.
